summary: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of common stock. The filing does not disclose deal terms such as price, size, or underwriting commissions, as amounts are left blank pending pricing. The offering is being conducted under an existing shelf registration statement (333-293459) with Cantor as sole bookrunner. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer conducting an ordinary equity offering with no merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or activist component. No board recommendation, premium, or structural complexity beyond standard underwriting terms is indicated. This filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) and does not represent a special situation.
